run_ip_adapter_face_id_pipeline: run the IPAdapterFaceIDStableDiffusionPipeline to generate images from text prompts with face identity reference
load_ip_adapter_face_id_weights: load IP adapter face ID weights from a pretrained model checkpoint into the diffusion pipeline
encode_text_prompts_for_generation: encode text prompts into CLIP hidden state embeddings for classifier-free guidance image generation
set_ip_adapter_attention_scale: set the IP adapter cross-attention scale factor to control face identity influence on generated images
build_ip_adapter_image_projection: build an IPAdapterFullImageProjection module that transforms image embeddings for cross-attention in the UNet
